mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as low rates reduce discount rates and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of all observations.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as lower discount rates increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of observations where FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicate strong economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of observations where FEDFUNDS < 1.0% AND UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansion, high housing starts (HOUST > 1200) signal robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of observations where the regime is 'late-cycle expansion' and HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) indicates economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants react to deteriorating labor conditions.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of observations where UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust economic output, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of observations where INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and strong consumer credit (RSAFS > 470000) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of observations where HOUST > 1200 AND RSAFS > 470000.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5%) signals economic overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as central banks tighten policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of observations where CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5%.
